label: TP
reason: Both alerts indicate user input reaches the response writer. Alert 1 (java/xss): User input from request.getParameter flows through multiple transformations (StringBuilder, HashMap, Base64 encode/decode, split) to 'bar' which is written to response.getWriter().printf() - user controlled data reaches HTML response sink. Alert 2 (java/tainted-format-string): Same flow shows user input reaches printf format string parameter 'bar', enabling format string injection. At least one alert is alert-TP (format string vuln confirmed via traced data flow).

evidence.note: User input from getParameter flows through transformations to 'bar' variable used as format string in printf
Sink: response.getWriter().printf(Locale.US, bar, obj) - user controlled 'bar' as format string enables format string injection
